name: NVIDIA API Catalog
description: Models of the NVIDIA API Catalog for your API key. NVIDIA does not publish your limits.

free.note: NVIDIA offers hosted models for development but does not state which ones an account may call, at what price or with which limits. The list is NVIDIA's whole catalogue, not proof of access.

limits.note: Often reported as 40 per account; not documented by NVIDIA.
